Scene 02

FBI HEADQUARTERS

Fox Mulder

I don't know what they did with the screen for this thing. Now, this is Angela and Wallace Schiff. It's a young married couple last seen hiking in the vicinity of brown mountain, north carolina. That's angie on the right. I should add this is the condition in which their bodies were found... After being missing for only three days in temperatures that never got above 70 degrees.

Dana Scully

Which rules out decomposition. I'd say predation, but the bones would be scattered.

Fox Mulder

Not to mention that these skeletons are not wearing any clothes.

Dana Scully

Right. Well, I'd say it looks like a double murder, possibly one with ritualistic overtones. The bodies may have been stripped, then skeletonized, possibly by boiling, or by the use of some kind of acid solution. Maybe the arrangement of the bodies... Has some meaning for the killer or killers. But at any rate, I'd term it "ritualistic."

Fox Mulder

That's a pretty big operation you're describing. There was no evidence found at the scene-- no tire tracks, no footprints, nothing.

Dana Scully

Well, what do you think this is?

Fox Mulder

It's brown mountain, Scully. That doesn't ring a bell? The brown mountain lights? It's a famous atmospheric phenomenon dating back nearly 700 years... Witnessed by thousands of people-- back to the cherokee indians. Strange multicolored lights are seen to dance above the peak of the mountain. There's been no geological explanation, no scientifical credible explanation at all.

Dana Scully

And what does that have to do with these two?

Fox Mulder

As I said, there's been no scientific credible explanation, but there are those of us who believe that these strange multicolored lights are really--

Dana Scully

UFOs? Extraterrestrial visitors... From beyond who apparently have nothing better to do... Than buzz one mountain over and over again for 700 years?

Fox Mulder

Sounds like crap when you say it. I'm just wondering if there's a connection, Scully. The conditions of these bodies are reminiscent of southwestern cattle mutilations-- cases where there's no physical evidence, and they've been associated with UFO activity.

Dana Scully

Mulder, can't you just for once-- just for the novelty of it-- come up with the simplest explanation, the most logical one, instead of automatically... Jumping to UFOs or bigfoot or--

Fox Mulder

Scully, in six years, how-- how often have I been wrong? [ scoffs ] no, seriously. Every time I bring you a new case we go through this perfunctory dance. You tell me I'm not being scientifically rigorous and that I'm off my nut. And then in the end, who turns out to be right like 98.9% of the time? I just think I've... Earned the benefit of the doubt here.
